name: component-connections-heat-nodes-classify-as-heat
source:
COMPONENT Hot(s)
s.t = 400
END
COMPONENT Wall(a, b)
a.qdot = (a.t - b.t) / 0.5
b.qdot = 0 - a.qdot
END
Hot H(w1)
Wall W(w1, w2)

error.message: There are 3 equations and 4 variables. The problem is underspecified and cannot be solved. Free quantity (no defining relation): w2.t. Coupled to: w1.qdot, w2.qdot. A common cause: an element chain with no constitutive law for that quantity — e.g. an efficiency-only machine or rigid pass-through between boundaries leaves its through-flow or a port pressure free; add an orifice/valve/flow-map element or pin a boundary value.
